chunks: And in it it is narrated that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who followed him from among the polytheists.
And He granted him authority over those who love to associate [others] with Allah.
"His authority is only over those who take him as a master and those who associate him with Allah."
He (peace be upon him) said: Therefore, the polytheists are more devoted to the worship of Satan than the believers.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific authority of Satan over believers versus polytheists according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this narration within the Shia doctrine of *Khud'* (divine authority) and *Tawhid*, emphasizing that Satan's dominion is conditional upon human choice rather than absolute predestination. This distinction underscores the theological principle that polytheists (*Mushrikun*) actively align themselves with Satan, thereby granting him greater authority over them compared to monotheists who resist his whispers.
